example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানটা যজ্ঞবাড়ীর মতো হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This wedding ceremony has turned into a grand affair.
Their party was a real big production.
history: Originates from Vedic rituals where yajna (fire sacrifices) were performed in dedicated enclosures, symbolizing large-scale religious gatherings in ancient Indian culture.
note: The idiom draws from Hindu sacrificial rites, often used metaphorically for any oversized event in Bengali speech.
